art.animal.name: Animal
art.animal.description: Animals of all kinds, from the fish of the sea to the birds of the air. Animal spells cannot affect people.

art.aquam.name: Aquam
art.aquam.description: Water and all manner of liquids, as well as the properties of liquidity.

art.auram.name: Auram
art.auram.description: Air, wind, and weather; also gaseous forms in general.

art.corpus.name: Corpus
art.corpus.description: Human bodies — living, dead, and those of magical or faerie creatures that look human.

art.creo.name: Creo
art.creo.description: "I create". Makes things better examples of their kind, including bringing them into existence from nothing and healing them.

art.herbam.name: Herbam
art.herbam.description: Plants and trees, including plant matter that is no longer alive, such as dead wood and linens.

art.imaginem.name: Imaginem
art.imaginem.description: The species the senses respond to — appearances of sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch — without changing an object's actual effects.

art.intellego.name: Intellego
art.intellego.description: "I perceive". The Art of perception: gathers information directly from the forms of things, undeceived by mundane disguises.

art.mentem.name: Mentem
art.mentem.description: Minds, thoughts, and spirits; also the "bodies" of noncorporeal beings such as ghosts.

art.muto.name: Muto
art.muto.description: "I transform". Grants or removes properties something cannot naturally have, such as giving a person wings.

art.perdo.name: Perdo
art.perdo.description: "I destroy". The opposite of Creo: makes things worse examples of their kind, or removes them from existence.

art.rego.name: Rego
art.rego.description: "I control". Changes the state of a thing to another state it can naturally have, such as moving it or putting a person to sleep.

art.vim.name: Vim
art.vim.description: Raw magical power; also affects magical, infernal, divine, and faerie creatures.
